objects.name: Analytic 2190
objects.description: Real-time monitoring identifies a new device connecting to an Industrial Control System (ICS) network switch port that was previously unused or previously assigned to a different device Media Access Control (MAC) address immediately following physical access to the environment, with subsequent Industrial Control System (ICS) protocol traffic to field devices. OT operational-fidelity gate: Alert only when the account/device/session violates the approved identity + source host/jump path/zone policy and is corroborated by access to a protected OT asset, execution, configuration change, or another security-relevant follow-on event. Suppress approved shift activity, vendor support, break-glass use, commissioning, and documented remote-access windows.
